items.title: George Blanchin Interview, 1959-11-13
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] I think it was Bob Coquille told me about it.

ctx.x: It's out by the lake. It's somewhere near West End. I'm trying to remember who told me about it. I think it was Bob Coquille told me about it. No. Red Mackey played there, somebody on that set.
